standard-dialogue-when-using-the-right-c.text: The player performs the beckon emote.

standard-dialogue-when-using-the-right-c.npc: Give me a moment...I can't move that fast.
I used to be a magician's assistant until the accident...

standard-dialogue-when-using-the-right-c.text: The zombie breaks in half at the waist, leaving behind an upper and a lower half.

standard-dialogue-when-using-the-right-c.player: Zombie, it has come to my attention that you are a fool, a nitwit if you will.

standard-dialogue-when-using-the-right-c.text: The player performs the laugh emote.

standard-dialogue-when-using-the-right-c.player: I propose that your head, instead of being filled with the brains you so crave, is instead filled with a mixture of crushed lemons and kelp!

standard-dialogue-when-using-the-right-c.npc: Oh noooo..I'd best take it off then...

standard-dialogue-when-using-the-right-c.text: The zombie's head rolls off, leaving them headless.
The player performs the cheer emote.
The zombie splits in two, then splices the one half and the other half back together.
